$comment: Layout + token snapshot of the Open Agents mobile concept (Pencil: open-agents-mobile.pen). The mock was corrected to use the app's monochrome design system (no off-brand accent). PNGs in this folder are the primary visual reference; the live editable .pen lives in the Pencil workspace, not the repo.

meta.theme: dark (primary); the app also has a light theme via the same tokens
meta.status: concept / IA + layout reference; the shipped /m implementation uses the app's real tokens

tokenMapping.$comment: How the concept's colors map to the app's globals.css tokens. The concept is MONOCHROME — primary actions use --primary, not a colored accent. Status tones reuse warning/success/destructive.

screens.name: Activity
sections: header: title 'Activity' + 'N repos · M need you'
filter chips: All / Needs you / Working / Done (with counts)
attention-first session rows: glyph (PR/branch/chat) · title (+unread dot) · owner/repo · branch · diff stat (+green/-red) · status pill · relative time
floating bottom tab bar: Activity · New (center, primary) · Me

screens.name: Chat
sections: header: back · title · repo·branch · status pill (Working=amber) · overflow
thread: right-aligned user bubbles; assistant text; collapsible reasoning; tool-call cards with diff / terminal output
tool-approval bar (pinned above composer when blocked): 'Approval needed' · command · Deny / Approve (primary)

screens.name: New session
sections: (repo mode) account selector · repo list · branch selector · Advanced (auto-commit / auto-PR)

sections: Activity · Repos · New (center, primary) · Loops · Me — frosted capsule; selected tab highlighted
